scope: Organic default, persistent Tiled UI toggle, partition-sized Skies, and fitted variant controls
browserChecks: Phone starts with readable, non-overlapping upright organic clouds
Phone Accounts toggle persists through reload and synchronizes another open page
Phone Skies sizes each view by its actual partition count
Phone layout switches and renaming preserve the existing partitions and their pages
Desktop starts with readable, non-overlapping upright organic clouds
Desktop Accounts toggle persists through reload and synchronizes another open page
Desktop Skies sizes each view by its actual partition count
Desktop layout switches and renaming preserve the existing partitions and their pages
The layout toggle keeps working when its device storage is blocked
Phone live board retains its move, selection, side and native cell targets across layout switches
Phone saved variant follows the chosen presentation without changing its recorded position
Phone a layout change preserves the mounted composer and its unsent word
Desktop live board retains its move, selection, side and native cell targets across layout switches
Desktop saved variant follows the chosen presentation without changing its recorded position
Desktop a layout change preserves the mounted composer and its unsent word
phoneVerification: Chromium phone emulation, not a physical iPhone test
